subtitle_en: New Year at Grandpa and Grandma's
author: Text and translation by Claude (Anthropic)

segs.en: The New Year was almost here.
Grandpa and Grandma had three children, and they all worked away from home: the elder son in Beijing, the daughter in the south, and the younger son abroad.
This year they were all coming home to spend the New Year with Grandpa and Grandma.
It had been several years since they had all spent New Year together.

zh: 新年要到了。爷爷奶奶有三个孩子，他们都在外边工作：大儿子在北京，女儿在南边，小儿子在国外。今年，他们都要回家，和爷爷奶奶一起过新年。他们好几年没有一起过新年了。

segs.en: Coming Home
On the day before New Year, Grandpa and Grandma were up at six in the morning.
Grandma got lots of food ready, and Grandpa waited at the door for ages.

zh: 新年的前一天，爷爷奶奶早上六点就起床了。奶奶准备了很多菜，爷爷在门口等了半天。

segs.en: At ten in the morning, the elder son and his family arrived by train.
At two in the afternoon, the daughter and her family arrived by car.
At five in the afternoon, the younger son and his family got back from abroad too.

zh: 上午十点，大儿子和他的家人坐火车回来了。下午两点，女儿和她的家人开车回来了。下午五点，小儿子和他的家人也从国外回来了。

segs.en: Now there were eleven people in the house! The house wasn't big, and it was full of people.
Grandpa and Grandma drank tea and talked with their three grown-up children.
The little ones ran around laughing.

zh: 家里有十一个人了！房子不大，人很多。爷爷奶奶和三个孩子一边喝茶，一边说话。小孩儿们一边跑，一边笑。

segs.en: Lele was the youngest in the family. She was four this year.
She ran behind her big cousins, shouting as she went, “Wait for me! Wait for me!”
Grandpa smiled and said, “This year we're all spending New Year at home. How wonderful!”

zh: 乐乐是家里最小的孩子，今年四岁。她跑在哥哥姐姐后边，一边跑一边叫：“等我！等我！”爷爷笑着说：“今年我们都在家过新年，真好！”

segs.en: Dinner Together
At six in the evening, all eleven of them sat down at the table to eat.
The table was full of food: there was meat, eggs, baozi, and Grandma's noodles too.

zh: 晚上六点，十一个人一起坐在桌子前边吃饭。桌子上有很多菜：有肉，有鸡蛋，有包子，还有奶奶的面条儿。

segs.en: After dinner they watched TV together.
Lele said, “Tonight I'm going to say ‘Happy New Year’ with all of you!”
Grandma said, “We say ‘Happy New Year’ at midnight. Can you stay up till twelve?”
“Yes!”

zh: 吃了饭，他们一起看电视。乐乐说：“今天晚上，我要和你们一起说‘新年好’！”奶奶说：“‘新年好’要在十二点说。你能等到十二点吗？”“能！”

segs.en: At nine, Lele was watching TV and eating fruit.
At ten, she sat beside Grandpa and went quiet.
At half past ten, Lele was asleep.
At midnight, the people on TV said, “Happy New Year!”
Everyone in the house stood up and said together, “Happy New Year! Happy New Year!”
Lele's mother wanted to wake her. Grandma said, “Don't wake her. She's too tired.”

zh: 九点，乐乐一边看电视，一边吃水果。十点，她坐在爷爷旁边，不说话了。十点半，乐乐睡了。十二点，电视里的人说：“新年好！”家里的人都站起来，一起说：“新年好！新年好！”妈妈想叫乐乐。奶奶说：“别叫她了，她太累了。”

segs.en: The First Day of the New Year
At six the next morning, Lele was the first one up. Everyone else was still asleep.
She went first to Grandpa and Grandma's room, then to Mum and Dad's room, then to her cousins' room.
At each door she called out, “Happy New Year! Happy New Year, Grandpa! Happy New Year, Grandma!”

zh: 第二天早上六点，乐乐第一个起床了。别的人都还在睡觉。她先去爷爷奶奶的房间，再去爸爸妈妈的房间，再去哥哥姐姐的房间。她在门口叫：“新年好！爷爷新年好！奶奶新年好！”

segs.en: Grandpa got up and said with a smile, “Lele, we said ‘Happy New Year’ last night.”
Lele said, “You said it, but I didn't! Today is the first day of the New Year, and I'm the first one to say it!”

zh: 爷爷起来了，笑着说：“乐乐，‘新年好’我们昨天晚上说了。”乐乐说：“你们说了，我没有说！今天是新年的第一天，我是第一个说的！”

segs.en: Grandpa gave her some money. “Then this is for the first child to say ‘Happy New Year’!”
Her cousins got up too. They looked at Lele's money and said, “Next year we're going to be first up too!”

zh: 爷爷给了她一些钱：“那这是给第一个说‘新年好’的孩子的！”哥哥姐姐也起来了。他们看了看乐乐的钱，说：“明年我们也要第一个起床！”
